title: lmdb: SAFETY comment misstates single-open invariant and omits real invariants
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs unsafe block (around line 68-77) SAFETY comment claims 'single-open invariant is the caller's burden' — but heed 0.22.1 already enforces this via a global OPENED_ENV RwLock; it returns Error::EnvAlreadyOpened if the path is re-opened. The comment is wrong. Worse, the actual remaining unsafe invariants are NOT mentioned: (1) the mmap'd file must not be externally modified while open, (2) NO_LOCK flag must not be used, (3) path must not be on NFS/CIFS. Future maintainers reading this comment will believe they need external locking that already exists, and will not know what invariants they actually need to uphold. Fix: correct the comment to reflect heed's enforcement and explicitly list the real remaining invariants.
